name: Trello
tagline: Cards, boards, lists, webhooks, and lightweight project API.
shortDescription: Trello provides a REST API for boards, cards, lists, labels, members, actions, and webhooks.
agentSummary: Agents can move cards, create tasks, and inspect lightweight workflows when board permissions are constrained.
bestFor: Simple project boards, content workflows, checklists, and operational task tracking.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Card moves and public/private board permissions need review. Project, CRM, document, and spreadsheet writes depend on team context and privacy rules; require least-privilege scopes and review for workflow-changing actions. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
authModel: API key/token, OAuth-like token authorization, and workspace permissions.
browserSupport: Board UI is the main review surface.

capabilities.detail: REST API covers boards, cards, lists, actions, members, and webhooks.
Developer docs include API reference and auth patterns.
Board UI is the main review surface.
